parsed_output.overall_summary: In this short interview clip, legendary chef and traveler Anthony Bourdain shares his personal 'fail-proof' hangover cure. When asked what 'winners' or athletes should eat to recover from a night of drinking, he provides a four-step regimen: aspirin, cold Coca-Cola, smoking marijuana, and eating spicy Szechuan food. He confidently asserts that this combination works every time.
